method: Joint E23/E24 fit of 21 temporal shape descriptors and 6 common-channel correlations. V2, V1V2, V3V4 only; median removal and per-channel RMS normalization. Median/IQR scaling and clipping at 5 IQR, equal temporal/coupling family weight. No frequency descriptors, amplitudes, digital counts, SCM, or configuration flags enter this fit. Saturated events are projected for inspection but excluded from fitting and groups. Three Ward groups are exploratory, not physical labels. Original E23 PC1 dust annotations are retained; the 3.1 threshold is not applied to new axes.
